purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Kisumu West Form 34B final TOTAL row and preserve an internal source denominator conflict without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: This official PDF carries a genuine machine-readable text layer (not a flattened scan). The TOTAL row was read directly from the extracted page text (page 2 of 3), which prints 'KISUMU MAIN - 01', 'KISUMU WOMEN - 01' and 'KISUMU MEDIUM - 01' (three special-facility polling stations) immediately before the TOTAL row, and matches the rendered page image exactly.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from both the rendered page image and the PDF's own extracted text layer, with identical results. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-239-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), sourced from the pre-election official IEBC First Schedule registered-voters gazette, published 2022-06-21

note: Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots and the candidate cells are individually clear and internally reconcile on the printed TOTAL row (candidate sum 59,077 = printed Total Valid Votes). However, the row's own printed Registered Voters figure (83,575) does not exactly match the separately governed P23 registered-voter denominator for this constituency (82,927). The 648-voter gap exactly equals the sum of three special-facility polling stations printed on the same page immediately above the TOTAL row: KISUMU MAIN - 01 (494 registered voters, code 049292145109601), KISUMU WOMEN - 01 (22 registered voters, code 049292145109701) and KISUMU MEDIUM - 01 (132 registered voters, code 049292145109801), which sit in a national-facility ward code outside the ordinary Kisumu West constituency ward series that the governed First Schedule denominator sums from. This is the same genuine printed-total-vs-ward-derived-denominator gap already documented for other constituencies' special-facility polling stations. Per the extraction contract's exact-reconciliation requirement for registered_voters (mismatch_treatment: unresolved), this row is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence until the denominator conflict is independently reconciled.
